text: FAA guidance indicates reestablishing or initiating emergency procedures after loss of control link, and requires a control link check before operations over people. There is no usable evidence from the DJI Matrice 30T manual in the approved collection. The incident reports are unverified forum claims describing sudden RTH with no warning, loss of control inputs despite video view, and flight logs showing strong uplink/downlink with no gradual signal drop. Main gap: these unverified accounts suggest behavior (sudden RTH) that may contradict guidance on control link procedures and loss-of-signal expectations, and there is no verified manual documentation confirming such sudden RTH without warning. Open questions remain about whether the forum claims reflect actual aircraft behavior or FAA-mandated procedures.
